name: Housebond Desires
source:
Your father has been arrested and is testifying against a crime syndicate.
You, your mother, brother and sister have been hidden away in a quiet remote town
under new names as part of witness protection.
A perfect chance to start a new life!
Except something strange is going on in the new house, and one unexpected encounter is about to turn everything upside down.
What new sides will you discover in yourself and in your family?
What secrets will you uncover? How far will you go with your desires?
translation:
你的父亲遭到逮捕，并作为污点证人出庭指证一个犯罪集团。
作为证人保护计划的一部分，你与母亲、兄弟和姐妹改名换姓，被秘密安置到了一座偏远宁静的小镇。
这本是开启新生活的绝佳契机！
可偏偏这栋新房子里正发生着某种蹊跷的异变，而一场突如其来的邂逅即将让一切天翻地覆。
你将在自己与家人身上发现怎样不为人知的一面？
你会揭开怎样的秘密？又会在欲望的驱使下越界到何种地步？
